title: Another Day
summary: The kettle hums, the street wakes up, and somewhere a bird has no idea what went wrong with my life. The light comes through the window like it always does, touching the dirty glass, the empty cup, the clothes I left on
content:
The kettle hums,

the street wakes up,

and somewhere a bird

has no idea

what went wrong with my life.

The light comes through the window

like it always does,

touching the dirty glass,

the empty cup,

the clothes I left on the chair.

It doesn't ask

if I slept well.

It doesn't care

what I lost yesterday.

A river doesn't complain

about the stones in its way.

It bends,

it passes,

it keeps no record.

Maybe that's enough.

Not everything needs a reason.

Not every bad day

needs to become a lesson.

Leaves fall.

Rain comes.

People leave.

Things break.

Then morning arrives

without an apology.

It’s new dawn

It's a new day.

Not better.

Not worse.

Just new.

And maybe life

was never asking me

to win.

Maybe it only said:

Walk when there is a road.

Rest when you are tired.

Let go when something is gone.

The sky will change

with or without me.

So I get up,

open the window,

and breathe.

Same world.

Same mess.

Another day.
